title: Reehan Picking out a Gift

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Oh, hello. Can I help you with something?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, hello. Can I help you with something?

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Alright, spell out for me what you need!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, spell out for me what you need!

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: I do. She is one of my employers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I do. She is one of my employers.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Let us find a mutually interesting item for you to bring her. To determine this let me ask, what are three types of things you enjoy doing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let us find a mutually interesting item for you to bring her. To determine this let me ask, what are three types of things you enjoy doing?

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't realize you were still here. Most people leave by now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't realize you were still here. Most people leave by now.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Music is the key to humanity. It's a spiritual connection that I, sadly, only comprehend in theory.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Music is the key to humanity. It's a spiritual connection that I, sadly, only comprehend in theory.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Unfortunately, my adaptive artificial intelligence module only allows for comprehension, not emotional synthesis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unfortunately, my adaptive artificial intelligence module only allows for comprehension, not emotional synthesis.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Danger! Danger! Something alluring and sexy about thrills. It's why your kind often seek it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Danger! Danger! Something alluring and sexy about thrills. It's why your kind often seek it.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: My humblest suggestion would be to the Oil Rig. The Separatists are making moves despite dwindling numbers. The fallout should be thrilling regardless of the actual outcome. If you can get a piece of something, I'm sure Freya and her bodyguards would be thrilled to add it to their political discourse collection.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My humblest suggestion would be to the Oil Rig. The Separatists are making moves despite dwindling numbers. The fallout should be thrilling regardless of the actual outcome. If you can get a piece of something, I'm sure Freya and her bodyguards would be thrilled to add it to their political discourse collection.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Oh, CORA no! I'm simply an observer when I'm able to be. Such is the nature of deep thinking androids. We possess rounded knowledge without expertise.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, CORA no! I'm simply an observer when I'm able to be. Such is the nature of deep thinking androids. We possess rounded knowledge without expertise.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: That's kind of you, friend. I'm delighted to have made your acquaintance. Now, what can this humble android do to be of service?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's kind of you, friend. I'm delighted to have made your acquaintance. Now, what can this humble android do to be of service?

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Unfortunately, given the state of our existence, the majority of beings inhabiting this world will require multiple avenues of servitude to tread water until they eventually drown.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unfortunately, given the state of our existence, the majority of beings inhabiting this world will require multiple avenues of servitude to tread water until they eventually drown.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Hmmm. So you need to provide a gift to gain audience. Fascinating...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmmm. So you need to provide a gift to gain audience. Fascinating...

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Of course. If I'm allowed to call you a new friend, let me just say that I've enjoyed our conversation and I hope it is the first of many.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course. If I'm allowed to call you a new friend, let me just say that I've enjoyed our conversation and I hope it is the first of many.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: For more reasons than you know. Alas, that is for another time. If you're a fan of music then you're in luck. Freya and her gang are fans of a musician named Finn Amano.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For more reasons than you know. Alas, that is for another time. If you're a fan of music then you're in luck. Freya and her gang are fans of a musician named Finn Amano.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Indeed. Return with something of his or, if possible, a new song, and you'll get in to see Freya again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed. Return with something of his or, if possible, a new song, and you'll get in to see Freya again.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Yes. I would look for Finlay Basin. He's an... interesting individual that I met at the OL Port awhile back. He seems to love the idea of the Separatists however I don't think they feel the same about him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. I would look for Finlay Basin. He's an... interesting individual that I met at the OL Port awhile back. He seems to love the idea of the Separatists however I don't think they feel the same about him.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: He's a bit of a loose program. All his lines of code don't seem to add up if you know what I mean.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's a bit of a loose program. All his lines of code don't seem to add up if you know what I mean.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: 'Tis in my nature to help those who have money to spend but don't yet know where to spend it. Well, if firmware can be considered equivalent to one's nature.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 'Tis in my nature to help those who have money to spend but don't yet know where to spend it. Well, if firmware can be considered equivalent to one's nature.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Though I am unsure if a discussion on free will for synthetics versus organics is what you are looking for right now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Though I am unsure if a discussion on free will for synthetics versus organics is what you are looking for right now?

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Feel free to come see me when you have something for Freya and her little gang.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Feel free to come see me when you have something for Freya and her little gang.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think so.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think so.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think so.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think so.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I hope so.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hope so.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I hope so.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I hope so.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not sure exactly WHAT I need.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure exactly WHAT I need.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not sure exactly WHAT I need.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not sure exactly WHAT I need.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you know Freya Portlet?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you know Freya Portlet?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you know Freya Portlet?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you know Freya Portlet?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I enjoy travel and going places I'm not supposed to go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I enjoy travel and going places I'm not supposed to go.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I enjoy travel and going places I'm not supposed to go.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I enjoy travel and going places I'm not supposed to go.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I like music I guess?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like music I guess?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I like music I guess?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I like music I guess?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: In theory?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In theory?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: In theory?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: In theory?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sucks. Need to get you a firmware upgrade.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sucks. Need to get you a firmware upgrade.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That sucks. Need to get you a firmware upgrade.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That sucks. Need to get you a firmware upgrade.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where can I find some?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where can I find some?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Where can I find some?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Where can I find some?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you a philosopher?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you a philosopher?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you a philosopher?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you a philosopher?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Then they're missing out on a good conversation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then they're missing out on a good conversation.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Then they're missing out on a good conversation.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Then they're missing out on a good conversation.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You have more than one employer?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have more than one employer?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You have more than one employer?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You have more than one employer?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I need to buy a gift to get her bodyguard and talk to her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need to buy a gift to get her bodyguard and talk to her.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I need to buy a gift to get her bodyguard and talk to her.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I need to buy a gift to get her bodyguard and talk to her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What would you suggest?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What would you suggest?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What would you suggest?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What would you suggest?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks, Reehan.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks, Reehan.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Thanks, Reehan.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Thanks, Reehan.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I've met Finn. Seems to be on a different planet.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've met Finn. Seems to be on a different planet.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I've met Finn. Seems to be on a different planet.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I've met Finn. Seems to be on a different planet.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll have to track them down.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll have to track them down.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll have to track them down.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll have to track them down.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I need to get a gift from the Oil Rig?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need to get a gift from the Oil Rig?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I need to get a gift from the Oil Rig?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I need to get a gift from the Oil Rig?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why not?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why not?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why not?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...Maybe?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...Maybe?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: ...Maybe?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: ...Maybe?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you still talking to me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you still talking to me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you still talking to me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you still talking to me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm a fan of getting myself into trouble then trying to get out again.
